educationalGoal: Students learn a principle of student instruction and the vocational counseling that accorded with education reform of our country and think about the purpose and significance, especially in junior high schools and high schools.
advice: Students learn the basics of practical leadership of the student instruction and the vocational counseling. 1. Student instruction ①Significance and purpose of the student instruction ②A domain and contents of the student instruction ③Problem of the student instruction ④Student instruction and other instructional activities ⑤Method of the student instruction-Collective instruction, Individual instruction 2. Vocational counseling ①Significance and purpose of the vocational counseling ②A theory and method of the vocational counseling-The history of the vocational counseling, Connection with the career education, Occupational development theory After having learned the content mentioned above, students investigate a contemporary problem about the student instruction and the vocational counseling and consider the way of the desirable student instruction and vocational counseling. They search the desirable instruction method or the way of the correspondence for the student and acquire a practical instruction technology and skill.
requiredKnowledge: ● Teachers expect the study of the student who strongly wants to be the teaching profession. ● Including the present society situation and educational issue, students should think about student instruction and vocational counseling while making use of one’s experience. ● Students should participate in group activity positively.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1)Students can understand a basic matter of the student instruction and clarity the problem, and can explain a concrete solution. (2)Students have enough knowledge about the student instruction, and utilize the knowledge variously and can give a student appropriate advice. (3)Students understand a theory about the vocational counseling and can perform instruction in deference to personality and the sense of values of the student.
achievementLevels.standard: (1)Students can understand a basic matter of the student instruction and can point out a problem clearly. (2)Students have enough knowledge about the student instruction and can think about appropriate advice. (3)Students understand a theory about the vocational Counseling can perform instruction that held down basics.
